# RX Tracker NEXT 4.0.0-next.15

This development candidate corrects relay call-attempt correlation. RX
Softphone remains version 0.6.0 because the Windows phone executable did not
change.

## Call-attempt correction

- A newly queued relay call now starts with clean dialing metadata instead of
  copying ringing, answer, end, outcome, or SIP-response fields from the
  previously completed call.
- Call Center now verifies the softphone call ID against the active attempt
  correlation ID before accepting a status snapshot.
- A delayed relay heartbeat for an older call can no longer end or mark the
  new attempt as answered.

## Validation

- Reproduced the original defect using an answered relay call.
- Added regression coverage for active-call correlation and clean relay
  dialing snapshots.
- Passed the Call Center phone-client, call-attempt lifecycle, shared-state,
  and managed-relay regressions.
- Passed the complete staging smoke suite, including the isolated
  Administrator/Call Center browser workflow.

## Planned development assets

- `server-update-4.0.0-next.15.zip` for the RX Tracker server;
- `RxSoftphone-0.6.0-win-x64.zip` for managed calling workstations;
- `SHA256SUMS.txt` if this candidate is later approved and published as an
  official release.

## Database impact

None. This candidate adds no migration and changes no table, column, index, or
constraint. It prevents stale call metadata from being written to new
call-attempt records.

Promote through `staging`, `develop`, and `main`. Keep the production `.env`
unchanged and use Project Control option 15 only after a tagged official
release is approved.
